description: The table lists annual well counts by municipal district in Alberta. The description includes development, exploratory, evaluation and experimental wells for natural gas, coalbed methane, crude oil, crude bitumen and other categories. Native dates cover 2003–2021. CSV, JSON and XML descriptors are present; a descriptor named XLSX is labelled URI, so that representation is not verified as a workbook. Counts concern wells drilled, not an inventory proving current operation, production rates or physical capacity. Exact category codes, locations within districts and completeness of annual observations are unstated. Alternate representations and the exploration interface remain one statistical resource. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Government of Alberta; Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says unrestricted; isopen is false.
